name: @athenode/cli
stderr:
Usage: athenode [options] [command]

CLI for athenode: project scaffold, config, and tokens.

Options:
  -V, --version               print the CLI version
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  init|i [options]            Generate skills, subagents, rules and MCP servers
                              for the selected ones of the 30 supported AI tools
                              from a plugin, show a plan of the changes, and
                              apply it after confirmation. A tool that loads a
                              plugin package from the project gets the plugin as
                              a plugin package (under .athenode/plugins/ with a
                              declaration in the tool's local settings file, or
                              in the tool's plugin directory); every other tool,
                              and a plugin tool another selected tool is
                              incompatible with, gets files. The plan states the
                              format of each tool.
  use [options] <entry-slug>  Install the latest version of a publicly displayed
                              plugin library entry into this directory, without
                              a token or an Athenode project: for the selected
                              AI tools, like `init`, with the plugin package and
                              its commands named after the entry. A repeated run
                              updates the installation to the latest version, or
                              reports it as up to date. In a project installed
                              with `init` it asks first (or needs --force). Run
                              `init` later to connect an Athenode project
                              instead.
  specs|s                     Manage specifications via the athenode REST API.
  todos                       Manage ToDo cards (follow-ups, tech debt, bugs and
                              ideas noted while working) via the athenode REST
                              API.
  plugins                     Manage the project's plugins, browse and edit a
                              plugin's file tree, and import external plugins,
                              via the athenode REST API.
  agents                      Manage agents attached to the installed plugin
                              (or, with --plugin-id, another plugin of the
                              project), via the athenode REST API.
  skills                      Manage skills attached to the installed plugin
                              (or, with --plugin-id, another plugin of the
                              project), via the athenode REST API.
  mcp-servers                 Manage plugin-level MCP servers attached to the
                              installed plugin (or, with --plugin-id, another
                              plugin of the project), via the athenode REST API.
  rules                       Manage the rules text blob for the installed
                              plugin (or, with --plugin-id, another plugin of
                              the project), via the athenode REST API.
  library                     Browse the public plugin library, add or merge its
                              entries into the project's plugins, update plugins
                              added from it, and publish plugins to it, via the
                              athenode REST API.
  mcp [options]               Start a stdio MCP server (server name "athenode")
                              exposing every CLI command except init as a tool.
  help [command]              display help for command
